assumptions: One CSV row is one frame; duplicate rows remain included. IDs are scoped to file and optional sequence.
Known runModel.py summary footers are excluded and counted as summary_rows_skipped.
For the frame_number,visibility,xyxy,confidence schema, blank detections mean zero unless overridden; xyxy geometry is validated automatically.
Totals exclude files that failed to read. issues.csv may include rows from a failed file before its error.
Detection counts count stored box entries, including invalid entries flagged separately.
Unknown counts are excluded from detection/mismatch rate denominators.
Confidence statistics use only numeric, finite values in [0,1], including unmatched confidence entries.
Visibility is one scalar category per frame; spelling and case are preserved.
Frames omitted from the CSV cannot be counted. No ground-truth accuracy metrics are calculated.
